note: Phase 2 closes what it can prove and defers the rest explicitly. Every Phase 2 function row in inventory.json appears exactly once below, and validate_inventory.py enforces that, recomputes the counts, checks every gate against the real target registry, and rejects a closure that claims a falsification it does not carry. There is one proof kind per gate and both require a mutation: the proof kinds that rested on a free-text observation were deleted, because a run can name a real step and still never enter the row, and every error review found was one of those rows. The 48 rows they carried were re-measured by a mutation probe; 5 of them could not produce a detection and were demoted here rather than kept. Where the guarantee ends: recomputed counts and a required non-zero mutation delta make the strongest claim the costly one, but they do not make a false one impossible. The probe transcripts are not committed artifacts, so a fabricated mutation string with a plausible delta beside it would pass this validator. What is checked is that a claim of the shape exists and is internally consistent; what is not checked is that the run behind it happened. Two further limits are in the numbers themselves. Most of these deltas come from an entry probe -- a print at the top of the row -- so what they establish is that the gate enters the row, which is what the deleted kind asserted without checking; they do not establish that the gate would notice the row computing the wrong answer. And a static_proof_falsified row has no oracle side at all: it is checked against expectations read out of the disassembly, so it is only as good as that reading. One row is closed by a later phase: phys_fn_001690 was deferred homeless_shared_code with driving_phases [3, 4] because no Phase 2 entry point reaches it, and Phase 3's capsule/capsule entries are the reachability it lacked. It stays a Phase 2 row -- ownership is a census fact and the stray rule keeps one row owned by exactly one phase -- and what moved is the proof, so it is recorded here with discharged_by_phase rather than on Phase 3's ledger. P4 Task 1c removed 19 rows from this ledger because the census no longer gives them to Phase 2: 14 qhull rows, phys_fn_004886 of IcePrunable.cpp, and phys_fn_004836/004840/004846/004847, which the source correspondence map identifies as OPCODE Ice/IceContainer.cpp members. The last four were closed here on static proofs; those proofs measured real behaviour and are reproduced in gates/phase2.json as the third_party_container_rows_moved escalation, but the ledger entry that authorised their inventory state left with the row, so the four are back at 'reconstructed' and Phase 4 has to close them again. Every remaining number here is recomputed from the entries below.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row's reconstruction in a throwaway tree, rebuilt, and run through every Phase 2 differential target; the recorded stdout_delta is the largest one produced and the gate is the target that produced it
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row and the static-proof gate failed the named check; there is no oracle side, so this is weaker than any differential
proof_kinds.oracle_differential_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row's reconstruction in a throwaway tree, rebuilt, and run through an oracle differential -- a target that loads the pinned DLL in its own process, checks its hash, and calls the recorded internal address directly; the recorded mismatches count is what that target reported against the shipped bytes. Phase 2 has no such target of its own, so every closure of this kind carries discharged_by_phase naming the later phase whose gate produced it, and that phase must be one the original deferral listed in driving_phases

deferred_reasons.blocked_on_later_phase: the row or the implementation it forwards to belongs to a phase after 2
deferred_reasons.unreachable_in_phase_2: reconstructed, but no input sequence through the Phase 2 public API enters it; for the rows demoted here that is a measurement, not a judgement -- a mutation was applied and every target read a delta of zero in the same run that a positive control read non-zero
deferred_reasons.not_independently_falsifiable: the row has no counterpart in the candidate that can be mutated on its own: it is emitted by the compiler from a construct belonging to another row, or its distinctive behaviour has no consequence any gate can observe
deferred_reasons.homeless_shared_code: shared_by_callers with no translation unit span; not drivable from any Phase 2 entry point, and not linkable for a static proof either
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: a Phase 2 data object that Task 4 did not disposition; Task 5 owns the data half of the census and this list makes the debt countable rather than silent

measured_from.method: breadth-first over the union Ghidra/Capstone call graph through the census owner map
